rev6.release_notes:
Sub Call: with Safe retract 6.0, every hole now rapids to the cycle's R plane (Z.1) before the G01 Z0 plunge - after the G43 line and after each hole's X/Y move - instead of feeding down from 6 inches.
Simulate: a Tool Definitions size is used only for the program it was typed for; O00242's (T1 CENTER DRILL) is drawn as a 1/4 center drill, not .010, and its false red holder marks are gone.

cadcam.release_notes:
2D Adaptive: its toolpath is worked out in the background - opening one no longer freezes the window (a 74 s freeze on a simple part is now about a quarter second); every toolpath comes out the same.
Picking holes, walls and lead-in spots: a click whose mouse moves a little still picks, and the view no longer turns by itself.
Spiral Interpolate starts with the largest end mill that fits the holes it cuts; a tool you pick stays.
Recognize Part: the corner brackets sit on the picked feature's own corners and turn with the model.
Closed command panels are freed: a long session stays smaller and the app closes faster.
